title: Design Log Storage System
summary: Design a log store with put(id, timestamp) and retrieve(start, end, granularity), where timestamps have year:month:day:hour:minute:second fields. retrieve returns the ids whose timestamp, truncated to the granularity, lies in the inclusive range formed by truncating start and end to the same granularity.
inputFormat: put takes an integer id and a timestamp string 'YYYY:MM:DD:HH:MM:SS'; retrieve takes two timestamp strings and a granularity in {Year, Month, Day, Hour, Minute, Second}.
outputFormat: retrieve returns a list of ids; the draft says the order is unrestricted (not verified).
tieRules: Result order is stated as unrestricted in the draft only.
edgeRules: Id uniqueness and timestamp ranges are not recorded.

examples.label: authored-reference
examples.note: Id 3 is excluded because its hour 00 is before the truncated start 01.

factsMissing: Official bounds for timestamps and calls
questions: Is the retrieve result order unrestricted (any order), or ordered by id or time?
Is each id put at most once?
